objects.name: Hypothetical BPF-gated output with an embedded object
objects.description: Illustrative behavior based on a reverse-engineering puzzle: a userspace ELF contains an EM_BPF object that gates output on a syscall sequence, while static tables suffice to reconstruct the output. This does not identify a real adversary or malicious deployment.

objects.name: Inventory and review embedded BPF objects
objects.description: On approved host binaries, validate embedded ELF/BPF structure and tracepoint sections, compare file identity to an authorized loader inventory, and preserve any loaded program and map state before removal.
